recommendation: Keep the empty external-repo audit commit for FHIR-core. If the moved EvidenceReport profile in the Evidence Based Medicine on FHIR IG has stale PICO wording, reconcile that external IG separately rather than restoring the removed core EvidenceReport resource.
issue_request: FHIR-31870 was a Published/Persuasive CDS technical correction for R5 asking the EvidenceReport Scope and Usage PICO wording to say "population, intervention/exposure, comparator, and outcome" instead of "population, exposure, comparator, and outcome".
initial_application: The Jira-linked commit af7ea5d38f9e6fe7c9ab5a05218a3a2b15ca7b49 changed source/evidencereport/evidencereport-introduction.xml exactly as requested, as part of a 2021 CDS correction family touching EvidenceReport and related Evidence pages.
additional_context: FHIR-31867 later resolved that EvidenceReport should be replaced by an EvidenceReport profile of Composition. Current history shows EvidenceReport was deprecated, removed from active source/fhir.ini resource entries, and source/evidencereport was deleted. Current core narrative points prior EvidenceReport users to the Evidence Based Medicine on FHIR IG, and active PICO-related core text no longer contains the rejected "population, exposure, comparator" sentence.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The former EvidenceReport page target is outside the current FHIR-core build and checkout, so reintroducing or editing source/evidencereport would be out of scope for this R5 wording correction.
